courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: Airbus A320 飛控架構
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課的工程脈絡由「判斷失聯與資料陳舊」推進到「導航來源一致性」，最後以「轉換、取消與接管證據交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
courses.summaryEn: The engineering progression moves from Distinguishing link loss from stale data through Consistency of navigation sources to Transition, cancellation and handoff evidence. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

history.title: 民航無人機失效返航概念
history.text: 本課的工程脈絡由「判斷失聯與資料陳舊」推進到「導航來源一致性」，最後以「轉換、取消與接管證據交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
history.textEn: The engineering progression moves from Distinguishing link loss from stale data through Consistency of navigation sources to Transition, cancellation and handoff evidence. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

courses.connection: 以「把失聯處置看成狀態機和證據問題」為主線，在不連真實無人機的返航概念模擬台中依序完成判斷失聯與資料陳舊、返回概念的能量邊界、導航來源一致性、誤判失聯的影響、不同狀態的暴露量及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
courses.connectionEn: Follow Treat link-loss response as a state-machine and evidence problem in a Return-concept simulator disconnected from real drones, progressing through Distinguishing link loss from stale data, Energy boundary of a return concept, Consistency of navigation sources, Consequences of false link-loss detection, Exposure in different states, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
